hardware: Apple M5 MacBook Air, 32 GiB, macOS 26.4.1, AC power
comparator: Authored source-major Quadrants dense scalar K=1 kernel; same ESN update/readout
synchronization: Every 32 steps and completed scope boundary
resident_boundary: Zero reset before clock; teacher recurrence without history writes; download after clock
workflow_boundary: Zero reset, all teacher states and download, final-length host ridge fit, own readout upload, driven/free evaluation and output download
exclusions: Initial fixture generation, device allocation/upload, parity qualification and warmup
summary_policy: Point: median of three seed medians; range: min/max seed medians. Speedup: median of three seed ratios of medians.
qualification_policy: Float64 gates for chains/states/driven predictions and first16 autonomous steps; full drift reported
load_condition: Interactive desktop with background filesystem/media activity, including degree16/24 refinement. Near-unity ratios describe observations rather than a precise crossover threshold; all execution snapshots were AC-powered with no recorded thermal/performance warning.
